label: nyiso 29 synch-reserve [probe]
definition: REJECTED PROBE (keeper stays nyiso-27 cc-offer). Path A of the downstate synchronised-reserve fix: a NYISO-only default-off lever adding a NYC 10-min SPINNING sub-requirement (0.5 x NYC 10-min total = 250 MW, the published 1/2-largest-contingency rule) supplied by an ONLINE-bounded reserve class (R <= sum online P), forcing idle NYC peakers to commit. Confirms the mechanism (CT_PEAKER 2023 -1.30->-0.92, 2024 -1.51->-1.05 TWh; CC over-run down) but INSUFFICIENT for the tail (C3c >$300 unchanged 1/0/8; C3a 2024 -9.7%->-11.0%) -- the grounded 250 MW spin clears cheaply and never fires the RCPF, exactly PR #877's prediction. Scopes path B (zonal/family commitment-aware reserve). Lever reverted on the branch; implementation preserved in the bundle model_changes.diff.
